$schema-comment: Compose MD3 parity budgets per twinned example. An example listed here must have a twin registered in e2e/reference (twinFor); the nightly renders the twin on the same emulator and pixel-compares it against the WaterUI capture. 'default' is the strict fallback fraction; recorded budgets are the measured divergence plus headroom — WaterUI and Compose rasterize text through different stacks, so first-run numbers are expected well above the Apple side's 2% and land here after measurement.
